title: The Cheapest Roubaix SL8: Unpacking Specs, Features & Comfort Tech

takeaways.text: The base model uses the same FACT 10r frame as every non-S-Works Roubaix SL8, claimed at 950 g, with about 40 mm tire clearance and a lower bottom bracket than before.
Future Shock 3 gives the rider up to 20 mm of travel; the base version has no damping adjustment but takes three swappable springs, and the Pavé seatpost clamps low for extra flex.
Mounts for a top-tube bag, three bottles and fenders, but none for racks or frame bags.
US$2,999 with Shimano Tiagra 2×10, threaded bottom bracket, flat-mount hydraulic brakes and 25 mm-internal wheels with 32 mm non-tubeless tires.
A size-56 base Roubaix SL8 weighed 21.42 lb (about 9.7 kg).

disclosure: No relationship with Specialized is stated.
summary: A walkaround and weigh-in of the 2026 Specialized Roubaix SL8 base model with Shimano Tiagra.
